description: This is a React functional component written in TypeScript that manages a preferences section for handling package extensions within a web application. It includes code for loading, installing, and uninstalling external plugins or extensions, handling user interactions, and rendering the related UI elements.

methods.name: loadExtensions
methods.description: Asynchronously loads extension items from the application based on specific ContentType filters.

methods.name: uninstallExtension
methods.description: Prompts user to confirm uninstallation of an extension, then deletes it if confirmed.

methods.name: submitExtensionUrl
methods.description: Downloads an external feature from a URL and prepares it for installation.

methods.name: handleConfirmExtensionSubmit
methods.description: Handles the user confirmation for installing a downloaded extension and resets related states.

methods.name: confirmExtension
methods.description: Inserts the confirmed extension into the application and triggers synchronization.
